question: Sunanda Nair is famous for performing which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__Mohiniyattam__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sunanda Nair** is an Indian dancer who performs Mohiniyattam, a dance form.
 
• She was the** first student** to earn a master's degree in Mohiniattam.
 
• She was awarded Global Mannam Award, Nrithya Seva Mani Award, and many others.
 
• She is an icon in her field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India has **two types** of dance forms-

 
 
• Classical
 
• Folk
 
 
 
• Classical dance form originated from** Natya Shastra**. There are eight classical dance forms in India:
 
 
• Bharatnatyam
 
• Kathak
 
• Kuchipudi
 
• Odissi
 
• Kathakali
 
• Sattriya
 
• Manipuri
 
• Mohiniyattam
 
 
 
• **Folk dances** are performed in respective communities. Every community or state has its own folk dance.
